about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in the colorful and chaotic world of modern art? Explore 5 unique maps filled with fascinating modern art pieces and discover the cats hiding among them. Color each scene by numbers and bring this lively world to life!

Each map features hand-drawn details full of abstract shapes, vibrant colors, and creative designs. Can you find the cats hidden in the chaos of art?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Calm this modern chaos with the relaxing power of colors and art!

✨ Features:
🌈 5 unique modern art maps
🐱 500 hidden cats in total
🎨 Paint-by-numbers system
🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure
🎧 Special themed modern art radio broadcast
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
